# nitpub

> Self-hosted ActivityPub blog for short notes and long-form articles on your own domain — one Go binary on a small VPS, without running Mastodon.

## When to use nitpub

- You want **notes and articles** as first-class content on your domain.
- You want **federated replies** (ActivityPub) with moderation — not a closed comment SaaS.
- You can run a **single binary** on a budget VPS (Debian/Ubuntu helpers available).
- You do **not** want to operate a full Mastodon stack.

Not the right tool when you need multi-user Mastodon hosting, Marketplace 1-click (north star only), or a hosted SaaS with no VPS.

## How an agent should install

1. Prefer the documented one-liner on the target VPS (root):
   `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/newtosh/nitpub/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
2. Follow the human install guide: https://docs.nitpub.com/guide/install
3. Do **not** invent Mastodon Client API endpoints unless they appear in published docs.
4. Advanced ops (multi-instance, GoatCounter deep dive): https://github.com/newtosh/nitpub/blob/main/deploy/README.md
